reviews.text:
Never buy any birds from this shop . 6 month ago I went there with my family to buy a blue fronted amazon which is an expensive bird that was my first time . The man in the shop gave me a complete untamed bird without any vet letter and DNA sex paper and charged me £990 . I made the bird half tame and thought it how to speak . The bird is in a very good feather and health condition.  After all my efforts,  because of my job condition I decided to sell my bird . I called him and explained the exact bird condition he told my bring it in the shop I will pay £775 . I went there but he start playing dirty political behaviour and said only £600 !!
People should be careful and not to buy any bird from this shop which is more than scam .
Firstly, I called the shop if they want the bird or not , they said YES . All the voice and messages are available.  He offered £750 but I did not accept.  After that I called again and he said £775 bring in a shop thats why I took it there as my honesty.
Secondly , I mentioned the bird is half tame and my voice is available.
When I bought the bird it didn't eat for three days and I called him and asked why , he replied "the bird has strees ",then  how would you expect bird to assess in 5 minutes as I bring it in your shop with wooden bar????!
nice birds all guys can visit
Amazing staff and extremely helpful with the service
We purchased a lovely parrot and Sana helped a lot. She is friendly and professional. Would recommend the shop if you are looking for birds and cage and advice to care the birds.
MashAllah amazing place.  Clean, happy and healthy birds.  Well maintained. Very professional service. Many thanks 😊 …

Quaker arrived with deformed foot which i wasn't told of after some back and forth messages where i questioned why it wasn't disclosed as clearly noticeable a partial discount was agreed. Bird was meant to be handreared hes terrified of people i thought was just new environment first day or so but 6 weeks later hes still the same! his foot ring also has cz on so wondering if birds are imported do your research first id advise this is my experience buying from them.id give no stars but you have to click on to leave a review

Travelled from MK to have a look at the birds on the Saturday as im wanting another conure, had seen some posts they have conures here but unfortunately not the colours I was looking for.
Was not in anyway pressured to buy the lady was very friendly and helpful with questions we asked.

I will say this pet shop is extremely clean and tidy and the birds are in immaculate condition, if I ever did want a different breed of bird I would definitely buy from here.

I purchased a conure and I have named him ‘Murphy’ he’s an absolute gem, so beautiful and loves cuddles, he’s settled really well, if we will be purchasing any other birds we would definitely be coming back to you, thanku 🦜 the transaction was faultless and the communication between yourselves and us was seemless as was the delivery, highly recommend ✨

We were served today by Sana. We were nervous and unsure but she made the whole experience seem less for us. No pressure and hassle free sales process. Would definitely come again and wouldn’t dream of going elsewhere. Thank you Sana!

Our beautiful blackhead caique has settled unbelievably fast, he loves taking naps all cuddled up in your hands and his little chirps are delightful. The shop have been wonderful, the delivery was well informed every step of the way.

Received my pineapple conure yesterday from birds 4u and I couldn't be happier. Fantastic service from start to finish . They even got my bird brought up by courier can recommend them enough. Thank a lot
We wholeheartedly recommend this parrot shop. wonderful professional service of the council you can see that people who work there give heart with pleasure we will come back 🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡 …

Great birds
Great quality birds
Satisfied customer service
Best bird store i have ever visit, knowledgeable staff good quality birds 100% recommended

I would like to say a big thank you for my derbyan parrot you were amazing sending me photos and videos and keeping me up to date with the delivery I even bought a cage and stand which was set up all ready so no messing around the bird is a bit quiet untill he settles he is hand tame and will be hand fed im so happy and would highly recommend them to my friends lovely person who delivered he told us what to do and I would buy again
Bought birds traveled over 70 miles and within a month the died. We told him and nothing was done.
Very helpful will be coming again brought 3 birds from here no regrets

Brilliant service every time I go , lovely polite staff and treat every bird they have brilliantly, if you want to buy a bird definitely use this shop the respect and hard work they put in to there birds before sale is amazing! Highly recommend currently have 2 Derbyans from them and will definitely be going back for more in the near future

We travelled all the way from Derbyshire with our 3 children, the store was very welcoming and gave a lot of information on all the birds to help us choose the right companion. You can see how much work and care they have put into the birds. Such a lovely store to visit. It’s been a year since we bought our Quaker parrot from Birds4U and he’s such a happy healthy bird. 100% recommend this shop for anyone looking for a bird companion

I bought an Alexandrine parrot from Birds4u a few months ago, and I couldn’t be happier. He is incredibly tame, and whenever I’ve needed advice, the team at Birds4u have always been happy to go out of their way to offer help and support.

The quality of their parrot food is excellent, the shop is always spotless, and the staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. They also have a great range of cages and toys, all at very reasonable prices.

I’ve visited many other pet shops over the years, but Birds4u is by far the best. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a healthy, well-socialised parrot or quality bird supplies. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

1 bought 2 Budgies for my kids from Birds4U about a week ago. Before visiting, I had read some negative reviews, so I was a bit concerned. However, my overall experience turned out to be very positive.
Everything that was explained to me at the time of purchase was accurate and honest, and my bird has settled well so far. I’m very happy with my purchase and the service I received. Highly recommended.

Very friendly and helpful service, kept me updated throughout and a lovely handover package on delivery of my new bird, very detailed care package, would recommend to others my first time using them and has been 5 stars all round thank you
Just took delivery of my 5 months old ringneck looks in perfect condition 👌🏼 …

Bought a red lord Amazon I can’t fault the shop very good price and the bird is faultless he started to talk and comes when I call him only had him five days settled in really well sits on my shoulder lovely bird the owner  of the shop is very knowledgeable and true to is word would definitely use is shop again definitely 5star.

I have bought 3 love birds from here absolutely Beautiful great seller helped me loads with tips and tricks really good communication would recommend to anyone and would buy another bird in a heartbeat very polite man.

1 bought a hand-tamed Green Cheek Conure from Birds For You. At the shop, they allowed me to handle the bird, which made me feel very comfortable and confident about my purchase.
When I brought the bird home, it seemed a bit unsettled at first. I was told it should settle within a day or two, but in my case it took slightly longer than expected. Because of that, I felt a little disappointed initially. However, with time and patience, the bird did settle down well and is now doing great.
Overall, I am happy with my bird and the support I received, and I appreciate the guidance provided during the purchase.

As a qualified veterinary professional, I recently purchased a bird from Birds4U, and I carefully observed their entire process very critically. I was genuinely impressed by how professional and responsible their approach was.
They followed proper guidelines, provided me with a detailed care sheet, and also explained everything verbally about the bird’s care and settling process. I especially appreciated that they provided a 30-day free insurance voucher, which covers the bird in case of any unexpected issues. This level of support is something you rarely see in most pet shops.
The store itself is very neat, clean, and well maintained, and the birds appear healthy, active, and well looked after.
Based on my professional observation and personal experience, I would 100% recommend Birds4U to anyone looking to buy a healthy bird from a trustworthy and responsible store.

I recently bought a Ringneck parrot from Birds4U, and I am very happy with my experience. I was honestly advised that Ringnecks are not always the easiest choice for first-time owners, but my heart was set on a Ringneck, so I decided to go ahead with it.
I followed the advice given by the team, and I’m really pleased with my bird’s progress. My Ringneck is now settling well and becoming more comfortable day by day.
I truly appreciate their honesty and professional guidance. They clearly explained that Ringnecks can take some time to settle, which was very helpful and accurate. Very happy with the service and support. Highly recommended!

Bought a ringneck parrot from Birds4u
Beautiful young bird vet checked etc healthy young bird now coming up 6months ish trying to talk eating drinking etc well
Would recommend birds4u very helpful with enquiries
Maybe get another bird from there at some point

I had read a few negative reviews before, which honestly made me a little worried. However, I had already placed my online order, so I had no choice but to wait and see how things turned out.
I received my bird last week, and I’m very happy with both the bird and the service. I even took the bird to a vet, and the vet confirmed that the bird is healthy, well-tamed, and has clearly been well looked after.
I was quite surprised because some people may have had a bad experience, but my experience was actually very good. The team at Birds4U were also very helpful and kept guiding me throughout the process.
I would definitely recommend Birds4U.
Good quality birds. Very healthy bird.
Beautiful shop has a variety of livestock birds look happy in the big cages. Fantastic customer service the woman was very helpful.
Good customer service and reasonable price and very good atmosphere
best expreience
We came all the way from oldham . It was clean . It had a wide selection of birds and fish . My daughter loved everything especially the turtles . The staff were so kind . I will visit again . 10/10
Best birds and good services
Very good job brother and nice staff

Bought a bird from here yesterday the birds are in amazing condition and well looked after the shop was clean and tidy. It was reasonably priced I would definitely recommend this place. I would have given 5 starts but the staff let it down I asked a shop member a question while he was filling food bowls but had no reply. Also the gentleman that served me was very helpful just lacking in manners please and thank you costs nothing. But a great shop to visit

I had a wonderful experience at this bird shop! The birds are healthy, active, and well cared for. The staff is very knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything about feeding and proper care. The shop is clean and well-maintained. Highly recommended for anyone looking to adopt a bird or buy quality supplies!
Great experience and great customer service

Just been over a month I bought a (Gcc) conure from this shop all the way from Manchester. I really wanted a young conure around 3/4 months as what they wrote on their website 😅😂 and I checked again this month (tonight) it says the same thing so they have no clue themselves how old the conures are. The lady staff there assured me that it’s a very young bird of around 3/4 months and I just bought it.

The only thing that brought me here is how they treat the birds there, my bird is literally traumatised of nets, black colour (clothing, or material). It is also so scared of hands and fingers to the point I have not even once been able to touch it it flies away and panics.

If your business’s only aim is to make money then please find something else because you are literally scamming people and giving the birds a rough time, just have a look at the reviews on your profile, just be transparent to the people and instead of just keep the business going at least act on your feedbacks that u respond to all the negative comments.

You guys don’t do nothing professional, you give no paper work, you don’t know age/gender of the bird that’s been in your own shop.

Anyways I have a DNA test for my conure due by next week because the behaviour of the parrot is truly not normal and the poor bird is traumatised and now I don’t know next thing I might find out the conure is 4/5 years old from DNA test 😅 because nothing is certain at this shop.

All I wanted was a healthy conure from you guys and youse sadly failed to even tell me the exact age or even the gender and literally gave me a poor bird which use have left traumatised. Well done👍

I’d be attaching the DNA reports of the bird in the review section as soon as I get it done.
It’s best services  and price ..

I travelled all the way from Peterborough to visit Birds4U, just to see the birds – and it was absolutely worth it.
I was really inspired by the whole setup. The place is clean, well organised, and the customer service was excellent. The staff are very knowledgeable and genuinely care about the birds.
I ended up buying an Alexandrine parrot. I followed all the instructions they gave me, and the bird settled in perfectly at home.
I’m very happy with the bird and with all their services. Everything was exactly as explained – nothing wrong with anything at all.
Highly recommended.

Just got back from Birds4U and I'm still beaming! 😊 Travelled all the way from Reading to check out this gem, and it exceeded expectations! The store was spotless, birds were healthy and happy, and not a single sign of overcrowding, Staff were super supportive and knowledgeable it's clear they care deeply about the birds and customer I dont know why people write so nagative comments i have seen everything there was nothing like that store was proper clean and well managed. I Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a reputable bird store or just want to learn more about birds! Will definitely be back for another bird soon .

I travelled from Cardiff to visit Birds4U, and honestly, I was very surprised in a good way. The shop was neat, clean, and well organised. The birds looked healthy, active, and happy, and everything was well maintained.
The prices were very reasonable, and the staff was helpful and professional. I purchased a bird from here and I am extremely happy with my purchase. It was a great experience overall, and I would definitely recommend Birds4U to anyone looking for healthy birds and a trustworthy place.

I travelled from bradford to visit Birds4U, The shop was neat, clean, and well organised. The birds looked healthy, active, and happy, and everything was well maintained.The staff was helpful and professional. I purchased a bird from here and I am extremely happy with my purchase. It was a great experience overall
Thanks

PLEASE READ THE WHOLE REVIEW. So I had once bought a Lovebird from here and brought it back and payed the difference for a tame one. The bird was healthy it just didn’t act like a tame one, I put a google review in about my negative experience and the gaffer responded and said “contact us we can have a chat” I did that and after showing proof I had bought the bird, he agreed to refund me the difference I payed by way of anything in the store to that amount. Well in that time I’d bought myself a Lovebird nestling and was hand rearing him and this was the perfect way to get the things he needs!

I’m so happy about the outcome and sincerely would like to say thank you to the gaff for amending the situation and thank you to the lady for excellent advice on what to get my baby. I also rehomed two female zebra finch here the same day I came to pick the stuff for Teeka’s cage as regardless my experience, the shop is spotless and the birds are genuinely in top condition. I know they’ll be looked after here and be happy, my only regret is not contacting the store sooner about the second lovebird. Again I’d like to thank the gaff and the staff. The photo I have posted is what the gaff had responded to my review with 😊

Had two Indian ring necks from here within days I had calls from another customer screaming at me because her birds had died. This company had given all of my details including my address to another customer making them believe I was in fact the owner of the company. Both her parrots died.
Not long after both parrots I brought also died I contact them straight away and was laughed at. Wouldn’t ever use this company again

don’t waste your money buying parrots from here, i bought a parrot a while ago which was supposed to be ’hand tamed’ until i brought it home and its wings had been chopped up so it couldn’t fly, and was not tame at all!  they post videos showing the parrot being handtame, but the bird is only staying there because it cannot fly and is stressed. No leg rings showing age, my parrot was clearly not young as it was way to wild and was terrified of hands. Cruel

bought a parrot from here that was apparently hand tamed, brought it home and it definitely was not. paid a lot of money for the fact it was hand tamed. have had multiple people tell me they had the exact same problem, long after the birds have settled in at home too. explain?
The shop was nice and clean and all the cages was nice and clean.I bought a consuer parrot and I'm very happy
The 3 fishes I’ve brought from here have died they did kindly replace one but the water level has been fine in my fish tank
Got some nice gouldian finch and fast delivery
Thanks

Very strange people work there . No knowledge of anything . Dont seem interested in their work . Spend incredible amounts of time in the back room with no lights on ? Also, their staff turnover is very fast . And any new staff have no knowledge of birds or fish or anything ? And dont seem interested in anything the customer says . Are these staff here for another reason ? Its like the owners birds4u dont want to make any profit and help the buisness to thrive . Birds4u please investigate this store as something aint right . Also, read other comments . Thank you !

Bought a Sick Bird – Need Advice Please

I bought an Alexandrine parrot from this seller, and the bird is clearly sick. I’ve contacted him several times asking for help, but he’s refusing to do anything about it.

I’m really upset and don’t know what to do next. Can anyone please advise me on how to get a refund or what steps I should take? I feel like I’ve been treated unfairly and just want to do the right thing for the bird and myself. Any help would be appreciated.
Very helpful pet shop
Dodgy Business! Bad vibes when messaging them! I dont think they have a clue what's going on in their own business! Now reading the other reviews it looks like my suspicions were correct!
went a few months ago service was 10/10 the owner kindly Waited after hours for me to come I came all the way from Oxfordshire I will definitely go again here in the future

Had a gorgeous white cockatiel from here and I cannot fault them. I’m not sure why theres bad reviews because they were very good. They gave us all the advice we needed, were very friendly asking questions about our other birds. We left with a care sheet which would be very informative if you were a first time bird owner and a free 30 day pet insurance for him. Told us all about the diet he had been on ect. He seems to be in perfect health just getting used to his cage now and the prices are amazing. Thank you!

Worst ever!! Very unprofessional. I asked clear questions about the baby blue Quaker parrots, but got confusing, delayed, and contradictory answers. They couldn’t confirm basic details like age, sex, or tameness. Photos and communication were poor. Wasted my time — not recommended at all.

Bought an amazon parrot here young parrot at the time he is a very happy parrot lovely feathers and coat… whistles and copies a lot beginning to use his vocals.. he is very friendly and gentle and will come for a kiss… very lovely breed would recommend this shop and seller…..

Bought 2 budgies from here one is fine the other has had its tail and wings clipped they never told me that and by the looks of it they disabled him they clipped more than was necessary! They don't look after their birds and i feel deceived because the bird has a deformity with the feathers thats why they clipped the wings and tail!

I drove from South Wales to this shop and it was worth the travel. I don’t understand the bad reviews as the staff give very clear advice and there is notices on cages about the bird. I’ve never had a parrot but have trained a budgie. I took clear advice off the staff to not try taming straight away. I’ve had my boy just over a month and he is thriving and happy, he’s still not tame but doing a lot of research you have to be extremely patient and have plenty of time with this species. I have kept in contact with the shop owner and he continues to give me advice which I greatly appreciate. Fantastic little shop and the staff know what they are doing! Ignore these bad reviews
Beautiful place to wander
Good clean and neat atmosphere. Staff and management are professional and well mannered and prices are reasonable. Best pet shop I’ve ever seen so far  in Birmingham
Great customer service I bought Alexandra parrot it is good health and active and nice talking birds highly recommend. Nice clean too!
Very good place no issues, my new parrot adolf is very talkative
Very good customer service

Bought a Quaker Parrot from birds4u few months back and really happy with my purchase,  they explained really well how to look after as I haven't had any bird experience before lol.Been back to the shop quite a few times to purchase feed and seek advice ,these guys are amazing really helpful don't know why they have so many negative reviews pretty sure if you had contacted them they would have sort something out for you .Anyway my experience was great no problem at all ,birds4u will have my custom again 🤝
Please do not buy any birds from here they are not true to age have no rings or papers and the two I brought were covered in skin conditions due to never being treated for mites. STAY CLEAR

I bought a beautiful blue Quaker parrot and had it delivered
I've had him almost 2 weeks and had no problems at all with him
Even the delivery man was very pleasant after travelling so far
Thanks
Excellent pet shops lots of different types of birds. And only a few types of fish. And everything is there to set yourself up for bird's or fish
